instructions:
1. Start in a plank with hands shoulder-width apart and body in a straight line.
2. Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor.
3. Press back up to full arm extension.
4. Shift weight to one hand and rotate your torso, raising the other arm toward the ceiling into a side plank.
5. Return the hand to the floor and lower into another push-up, alternating the rotation each rep.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your body in a straight line through both the push-up and the rotation.
2. Rotate from the torso and brace your obliques to stay stable.
3. Exhale as you press and rotate, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep feet planted to give the rotation a stable base.
name: Push up and rotation

instructions:
1. Start in a plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and body in a straight line.
2. Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor.
3. Press back up to full arm extension.
4. At the top, push your hands hard into the floor to round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades.
5. Release back to a flat plank.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Emphasize the final push at the top to spread the shoulder blades.
2. Keep your core braced and hips level throughout.
3. Keep elbows tucked at roughly 45 degrees during the descent.
4. Move slowly to feel the upper-back rounding action.
name: Push up plus

instructions:
1. Start in a plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and feet together.
2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
3. Bend your elbows to about 45 degrees and lower your chest toward the floor.
4. Stop when your chest is just above the floor.
5. Press through your hands back to full arm extension.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced to stop your hips from sagging.
2. Lower with control until your chest nearly touches the floor.
3. Keep elbows at about 45 degrees to spare the shoulders.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
name: Push ups bodyweight

instructions:
1. Lie on your back and raise your legs straight up, vertical to the floor.
2. Place your hands behind your head with elbows pointing out.
3. Brace your core and lift your shoulders off the floor toward your knees.
4. Hold briefly and squeeze your abs at the top.
5. Lower your shoulders back down under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lift with your abs, not by pulling on your neck.
2. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
3. Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your legs steady and vertical throughout.
name: Raised leg crunch

instructions:
1. Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend one elbow and reach that hand up your back, palm facing out.
3. Walk the fingers up toward the opposite shoulder blade until you feel a stretch.
4. Hold, breathing steadily.
5. Release slowly and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly to avoid straining the shoulder.
2. Keep the spine neutral, do not arch the back.
3. Stop if you feel sharp pain in the front of the shoulder.
4. Keep shoulders down and relaxed.
name: Reaching up shoulder stretch
